transcript.answer: Otto doesn't run on Cloud Run in europe-north1 because the plan's premise stopped holding, and the deployment went to a different platform. Issue #27 chose Cloud Run in europe-north1 so the service would sit in the same region as the Vertex model. That reason no longer applied. Measurements on 2026-10-16 showed europe-north1 serves only the Gemini 2.5 family, which Google retires on 2026-10-20. The newer Gemini models answer only on the `eu` multi-region. Using the model's `global` endpoint would give up the EU residency that the model allowlist is there to enforce. The Cloud Run plan also rested on terraform roots that the repository never built, and neither the Cloud Run deployment nor the ADR-001 it called for was ever created. Otto instead runs with Helm on the shared GKE Autopilot cluster `n8n-cluster` in europe-west1 (Belgium), with the model on Vertex AI's `eu` multi-region. ADR-003 (decided 2026-10-19) records this and rejects the Cloud Run option. Issues #27, #162 and #168 were closed as superseded.

judgements.reason: The answer states that europe-north1 served only Gemini 2.5 (retiring 2026-10-20), that newer models are only on the eu multi-region, and that Otto runs on GKE Autopilot n8n-cluster in europe-west1, matching the gold answer.
